verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Entra ID supports app gallery submissions for SAML/OIDC apps and general app management/security configuration (permissions, MFA, tokens, certificates), implying support for custom enterprise app registrations beyond the gallery, but there is no explicit walkthrough evidence for non-gallery SAML/OIDC app configuration or header-based authentication (e.g., via Application Proxy). Missing for 10: documented non-gallery/custom SAML app SSO walkthrough, custom OIDC app registration walkthrough, and header-based auth (App Proxy) configuration steps.
